tools.name: list_smart_lists
tools.description: Browse stock screens by category — momentum, technical signals, fundamentals, earnings events, social sentiment, themes, curated baskets, investment theses — with display names, descriptions, member counts, and the per-tool pricing/allowance for the metered tools below. tools.name: get_list_criteria
tools.description: Metadata for one stock screen (smart list): display name, short description, icon, category ids and parent screen. Always free.

tools.name: get_smart_list
tools.description: Symbols currently in a stock screen — e.g. today's earnings, golden-cross buy signals, AI beneficiaries (paged, max 200 per call). Descriptive, not a recommendation. Free within your daily allowance (anonymous 5/day by IP, signed-in users 10/day, power users 50/day); beyond that $0.01 per call via x

tools.name: get_smart_list_metrics
tools.description: Per-symbol metrics for a stock screen — price and 1-day/7-day/1-month/3-month change, 52-week range, 50-day/200-day averages, forward/trailing P/E, PEG, beta, dividend yield, short interest, last earnings reaction and drift since, next earnings date, implied move, expectations score, and technical s

tools.description: The same per-symbol metrics as get_smart_list_metrics, plus the latest headlines, for your own watchlist — the tool behind "What's going on with my watchlist today?". tools.description: Today's market conditions: the daily overview narrative, the fear & greed index and per-sector scores, sector rotation and market-cycle phase, and categorized market news. tools.name: get_smart_list_changes
tools.description: Which symbols entered or left a stock screen since its last recorded baseline (which can span several rebuilds) — e.g. new golden crosses, or names that dropped out of the momentum leaders. tools.name: find_symbol_lists
tools.description: Every stock screen a given ticker is currently in — its momentum, technical-signal, earnings, theme and thesis memberships, in one call. Free within your daily allowance (anonymous 5/day by IP, signed-in users 10/day, power users 50/day); beyond that $0.01 per call via x402 (USDC).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_my_watchlist" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer, session token). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
